data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding (claims reserves) at 1 January 2016 is taken from the Balance Sheet comparative column (2015) as GBP 48.51m. The report does not present a clearly labelled gross prior-year reserve movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) that can be unambiguously extracted from the printed notes or triangle in the provided images. Gross written premium for 2016 is GBP 115.182m. Due to limited legibility of the technical reserves reconciliation and claims development table in the supplied images, a quantification of prior year development (gross) could not be determined.
